was nothing to score it on (no monitors for quality, no findings for sensitivity).

allowedChildNodeTypes.description:
Allowed child types, which may be either custom node types or catalog node types
(e.g. DATA_NODE_TYPE_SCHEMA). Supersedes allowed_child_types.

allowedChildTypes.description:
Deprecated: custom-node-type-only allowed children. Use allowed_child_node_types, which
also supports catalog node types. Still populated with the custom-type subset for
backwards compatibility.

allowedParentNodeTypes.description:
Allowed parent types, which may be either custom node types or catalog node types
(e.g. DATA_NODE_TYPE_TABLE). Supersedes allowed_parent_types.

backwards compatibility.

isColumnDisplay.title: If true, this node type will be displayed as a column in lineage UIs

showInImpactAnalysis.description:
If true, nodes of this type are surfaced as impacted entities in issue impact analysis (RCA)
when they lie downstream of an issue.

bigconfigNamespace.description: The Bigconfig namespace that owns this rule, if any. Output-only.

isBigconfig.description:
True when this rule is managed by a Bigconfig suite. Output-only: set by the backend
from the backing metric's creation state; ignored on input.

observedColumns.description:
Fully-qualified column names this rule observes (e.g. source.schema.table.column). Used as
Bigconfig suite input to link the rule to assets; resolved to dataset fields on apply.

Representation of a list of tables for API purposes

generatedSearchMethod.description:
Controls how a search term is matched against indexed names.

 - SEARCH_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED: Unset behaves the same as SEARCH_METHOD_EXACT_TERM.
 - SEARCH_METHOD_EXACT_TERM: Match the term exactly (no fuzziness). A term containing "*" is treated as a wildcard.
 - SEARCH_METHOD_CONTAINS: Per-word "contains" matching: split the term on whitespace; every word must match via a
"*word*" wildcard or a fuzzy match.

includeDataNodeId.description:
Hydrate the lineage node id (data_node_id) on schema/table/column results. This requires an
extra per-entity-type lookup, so only the lineage typeahead (which navigates by data_node_id)
sets it; other searches leave it false.

customNodeTypeId.description:
A specific custom lineage node type, identified by CustomNodeType.id. Selecting one
narrows search to DataNodeEntity nodes whose custom_node_type_id matches.

value.description: Value of the threshold. For AutoThreshold types this is ignored.
